title: SupportedClassGeometry
statement: Fix the finite datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], the input predicate of [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], exact pullbacks of [def-pur-compact-product-arrows], supported coefficient functors of [def-pur-supported-exterior-product] and supported signed-twist Hom classes of [lem-pur-supported-cup-functoriality]. For $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and closed $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$, $j:W\hookrightarrow Y$, define the map from the product support to the intersection of projection-inverse-image supports by its two pullback projections. The reverse projections have equal composites to the base; define their induced reverse map, whose ambient composite equals the intersection immersion. Define the pulled-back cup by the two supported pullbacks, the supported cup and change of support along the reverse map. Define the degree-zero coefficient unit and its multiplication, and identify the supported coefficient unit with the ordinary supported-Hom source. Convert a supported Hom class to a map out of the derived supported coefficient unit by the exact single comparison and this equality; pull back arbitrary such morphisms by the exact/left-derived comparison. Define the map from the tensor coefficient source to the ordinary supported unit source by coefficient multiplication and the same exact single comparison.
